subject: [PATCH v8 08/30] mm: recognize PMD swap entries in the softleaf layer

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies the softleaf layer in the Linux kernel to recognize and handle PMD swap entries. It introduces a new function `pmd_is_swap_entry()` that checks if a PMD entry encodes a swap entry, and updates existing functions to correctly handle swap entries. The changes include removing unnecessary checks for migration and device-private entries, and adding a check for swap entries in the `softleaf_is_valid_pmd_entry()` function. This patch prepares the kernel for installing swap entries directly into the PMD layer.
